issues.explanation: addMember has no authorize call so any member including employees can create memberships.
Role is cast to UserRole enum but code compares it to a string value so owner checks are always false and the owner can be deleted.
User.php defines methods inside casts method and duplicates them so the file has a PHP syntax error.
Entity extends Model with no import so App Models Model does not exist and the class cannot load.
Settings save delete and transfer rely only on mount authorization and never re-authorize each action.
Membership migration uses an invalid MySQL generated expression and virtual instead of stored plus a different SQLite partial index instead of the specified portable generated column.
Settings transfer compares enum role to string so it always aborts and never checks the vanished-owner case.
Dashboard isOwner compares enum role to string so it is always false and it can null-deref for edge cases.
removeMember only counts admins so it blocks valid removals and does not enforce the owner-plus-admin last-manager rule.
web.php deletes home auth login register password and verify routes which breaks existing behavior and is out of scope.
database-schema docs describe an owner_membership_id circular FK that the task never asks for so docs are out of sync.
No Pest or PHPUnit tests ship with the change including required unauthorized and tamper tests.
Livewire components use no Validate or Locked attributes and domain writes bypass app Actions with direct Eloquent and Log calls.
EntityMembership factory lacks the required employee state and EntityMembership model has unused imports.
User.php has duplicated membership methods and Entity files miss the base Model import with leftover unused imports.

conventions.evidence: app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:64 no Validate or Locked, no app Actions used, docs/database-schema.md:632 contradicts task, but fillable and down methods present

readability.evidence: app/Models/User.php:324 duplicated methods inside casts, app/Models/Entity.php:226 missing Model import, unused imports in EntityMembership.php

requirements.evidence: app/Models/User.php:324 syntax error, app/Models/Entity.php:226 missing Model import, app/Livewire/Entity/Settings.php:189 transfer never succeeds, database migration MySQL expression invalid, no lang or Blade views in diff

scope.evidence: routes/web.php:1 required entity routes added but all auth home password verify routes deleted, plus invalid Auth routes import

security.evidence: app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:73 addMember without authorize, app/Livewire/Entity/Settings.php:160 save delete transfer without authorize, EntityMembershipPolicy.php:411 enum-string owner check fails, public Entity swappable

simplicity.evidence: app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:80 direct Eloquent create without extra layers, no speculative abstractions, only User.php duplication

tests.evidence: change.diff:1 contains no test files, no happy-path or unauthorized or tamper coverage

review.summary: The change adds entities memberships policies and Livewire pages but User.php is syntactically broken and Model imports are missing. Security checks fail because enum roles are compared to strings and several actions lack authorization, plus routes deletions and missing tests require rejection.
